title: tube
body:
## tube

Builds a polygonal tube of constant radius around each line or polyline of polygonal input, typically streamlines from streamTracer, so that thin lines become visible shaded geometry in images and exports. The output is vtkPolyData, and input point arrays are carried onto the tube surface so it can be coloured by the same fields. Schemaxis assigns radius 0.1, 12 sides and capped ends; ParaView's radius variation stays off, so use pvTube for tubes whose radius follows a scalar or vector.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- radius is an absolute length in dataset units: 0.1 vanishes on a 100 m domain and swamps a 1 mm one. ParaView's GUI starts from 1% of the input extent, a reasonable first choice.
- Lines with repeated consecutive points are not tubed; run clean first if segments are missing.
- Schemaxis's serial native acceptance run (examples/schemaxis/extended-coverage.json) executes this operation once, on streamlines of a uniform analytic field; it does not check this operation's output values, so inspect the result on your own data.

Native constructor: `Tube`. Identity: `curated binding`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

| Port | Meaning / native port | Required | Multiplicity | Kind | Contract |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `input` | Required data input for the native Input port. Give the name of the upstream node to connect, or a {node, port} object to use another of its output ports. Accepted data: polygonal data (surfaces, lines or vertices) (vtkPolyData). | True | one object | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":null,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":["vtkPolyData"],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |

### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `radius` | Geometric tube radius around the centreline. Choose it relative to the case size; it does not change the integrated flow trajectory. | `{"type":"number","minimum":0,"exclusiveMinimum":true}` | `0.1` | `0.1` |
| `sides` | Number of polygonal sides around each tube. More sides make it look rounder and increase geometry size. | `{"type":"integer","minimum":3}` | `12` | `12` |
| `capping` | Close the ends of each generated tube. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `true` | `true` |

Execution contract:

```json
{
  "mode": "serial",
  "performance": "unknown"
}
```

### Syntax example

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json
{
  "id": "result",
  "filter": "tube",
  "inputs": {
    "input": "UPSTREAM_input"
  }
}
```
